title: Classic Pride Flags
description:
This mod adds pride flags to classic 0.30
a mostly experimental mod that took me about 2 hours to make
body:
# WARNING

This mod is highly experimental.

Worlds that were created with this mod installed, or worlds that have been used with this mod, will not work correctly after disabling or removing the mod.

Back up your worlds before using this mod.

# Classic Pride Flags

Classic Pride Flags adds pride flags to Minecraft Classic 0.30.

Flags can be placed on:

* walls
* floors
* ceilings

They also rotate depending on the direction you place them.

The mod is still unfinished, and more flags will be added in future updates until i eventually run out of tile IDs.

(Reminder that if you use prism you need to use add to minecraft instead of add agents or it wont work)

## Currently Included Flags

* Transgender
* MTF
* FTM
* Progress Pride
* Non-Binary
* Rainbow
* Gay
* Lesbian
* Bisexual
* Intersex
* Demigirl
* Demiboy

Enjoy 😃
